def find_lexicographically_smallest_string(S):
    # Convert the string to a list to perform swaps
    S = list(S)
    N = len(S)
    
    # Perform the swaps to get the lexicographically smallest string
    for i in range(N - 1):
        for j in range(N - 1):
            if S[j] > S[j + 1]:
                S[j], S[j + 1] = S[j + 1], S[j]
    
    # Convert the list back to a string
    return ''.join(S)
